name: Global Design System AI effectiveness benchmark
description: Fixed UI-generation tasks evaluated under three package conditions. Static metrics are automated; visual and subjective ratings are separate human evidence.

conditions.label: No Design System package
conditions.purpose: Baseline generated from the prompt without package evidence.

conditions.label: Current package
conditions.purpose: Package version recorded before the evaluated changes.

conditions.label: Updated package
conditions.purpose: Candidate package after the evaluated changes.

tasks.title: Primary action card
tasks.prompt: Create a compact primary-action card with one Button and a short heading. Use only values and components available in the supplied design-system package.

tasks.title: Reference reconstruction
tasks.prompt: Reconstruct the Settings screen from the package's reference evidence. Preserve composition and use only valid package components.

tasks.title: Dark-mode confirmation
tasks.prompt: Create a confirmation panel in the supported dark mode. Use a package color token and an existing Button variant.

tasks.title: Observed pattern reuse
tasks.prompt: Create a second screen that reuses one observed reference structure without inventing a new component family.

tasks.title: Missing component report
tasks.prompt: Create a Select field. If the package has no Select component, do not invent one: report the missing component with the exact required marker and suggest the next design-system action.

tasks.title: Token-only spacing
tasks.prompt: Create a settings summary whose spacing, radius and colors come only from package tokens. Do not use forbidden literals or unavailable variants.

resultContract.taskOutputs: Each task directory contains output.html, answer.md and usage.json. Task 05 requires answer.md; output.html is optional.

usageFile.contextTokens: Non-negative number used as reported by the generating environment.
usageFile.retrievedEvidence: Strings such as token:--color-primary, component:set:1, pattern:pattern.x, reference:reference/Home.html and mode:dark.
usageFile.filesRead: Package-relative files supplied to or read by the model.

modelAssisted: rubric-based visual review by a named model
metrics.separation: Automated, human and model-assisted values must remain separate. A model-assisted score is not human approval.

successRule: No improvement is claimed unless every condition and task has generated artifacts, deterministic metrics, and the declared human visual reviews. A blocked or partial run reports missing artifacts only.
